page: Amazon Web Services i7ie.metal-24xl is a storage-optimized bare-metal server powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8559C processors. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 96 vCPUs across 48 physical cores with a clock speed of 3.2 GHz and a substantial 320 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 768.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory running at 6 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per physical core. The hardware configuration is highly specialized, bundling a massive 60,000 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps, without any integrated GPUs.

In benchmark evaluations, the i7ie.metal-24xl demonstrates top-tier performance across multiple compute and data processing workloads. Its multi-core capabilities are highlighted by top-tier results in Passmark CPU tests, Geekbench multi-core scores, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. The processor's support for advanced vector and matrix extensions, such as AVX-512 and AMX, contributes to top-tier performance in extended instruction sets and cryptography. Memory bandwidth is also strong, with read-only cached small block transfers reaching 6647.5 GB/sec and large block uncached writes performing at 119.86 GB/sec.

The server's storage-centric architecture delivers exceptional database and web serving throughput. Passmark database operations and static web serving throughput both rank in the top tier, while Redis SET operations achieve strong performance at 117.71 million operations per second. For artificial intelligence workloads, the system exhibits top-tier prompt processing speeds for both medium and large LLM models, though text generation speeds remain average.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the i7ie.metal-24xl offers high resource density by combining massive local NVMe storage with a large DDR5 memory footprint on a bare-metal platform. This eliminates virtualization overhead and maximizes I/O throughput per resource unit. It is highly suited for large-scale relational databases, high-throughput NoSQL stores, data warehousing, and memory-intensive data processing applications that require direct access to physical hardware and ultra-low latency local storage.

It features 96 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8559C processor running at 3.2 GHz, paired with 768.0 GB of DDR5 memory. The server is characterized by its massive 60,000 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps. Benchmark results place this instance in the top tier for database operations, static web serving, and multi-core CPU performance, supported by advanced hardware extensions like AVX-512 and AMX. While single-core performance is average, its multi-threaded capabilities and high memory bandwidth make it highly efficient for resource-dense deployments. The i7ie.metal-24xl is ideal for large-scale databases, high-performance storage systems, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
